scope: Every registry package in the supplied Cargo.lock, including packages for other targets and optional build paths. Cache presence records this local Windows build cache, not proof that a crate was linked into the executable.
archive_scope: The companion dependency-source ZIP contains the cached .crate archives whose SHA-256 matches this lockfile. It is not a complete cargo vendor tree, a full cross-platform offline dependency set, or a bit-for-bit reproducibility guarantee. URLs for uncached locked registry packages are indexed; this inventory does not download them. Retain Cargo.lock, application/build sources and upstream licenses with the release.

rust_toolchain.source_note: The commit-pinned Rust source tree identifies the compiler/library revision reported by the installed compiler. Git submodules are pinned in that tree and may require separate retrieval; a GitHub archive alone is not asserted to be a complete offline Rust bootstrap checkout. The rust-src component below contains standard-library sources, not the full compiler source.
